stocks:MARUTI.NS.standing: India's largest carmaker, majority-owned by Japan's Suzuki Motor and built on small, affordable cars. Its sales are among the clearest readings of what Indian households feel able to spend on a big purchase.
stocks:MARUTI.NS.recent: Carmakers dispatched an estimated 525,000 cars to dealers in October, with Maruti leading the festive stocking. These are shipments to showrooms, not sales to buyers, so the figure records how much stock dealers took on for the season.

stocks:3690.HK.standing: China's largest food-delivery and local-services platform, listed in Hong Kong. Its shares answer to subsidy wars with rivals at home, Beijing's rules for platform companies, and the cost of expanding abroad.
stocks:3690.HK.recent: The one story about Meituan's own business was the release of LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model fitted onto sub-80GB Chinese chips, which puts its AI work on domestic hardware rather than imported accelerators. It landed at the end of the window, and nothing else in the input accounts for the share's path before it.

stocks:0941.HK.standing: China's largest mobile network operator by subscribers, controlled by the state and listed in Hong Kong. Its steady cash flow and dividends draw income investors, and its network spending drives orders across China's telecom and computing suppliers.

poly-israel-x-hamas-ceasefire-cancelled-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Israel-Hamas ceasefire is cancelled by Dec 31. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it reacts to fighting in Gaza and to the politics of the governments behind the truce.
poly-israel-x-hamas-ceasefire-cancelled-.recent: Bets on a collapse peaked just after Israel's parliamentary elections. They fell away through a week in which Israeli strikes killed at least 5 Palestinians, Israel shut the Rafah crossing and Trump said $4 billion in Israel aid stops at year-end. That was violence and pressure that left the truce formally standing.

poly-us-iran-hormuz-agreement-by-decembe.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the United States and Iran reach an agreement on the Strait of Hormuz by December 31. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, on a waterway that Gulf energy exporters and importers depend on.
poly-us-iran-hormuz-agreement-by-decembe.recent: The midterms pulled both ways: Vance said the Iran war lost Congress and Brent fell on peace hopes, but Mojtaba Khamenei said partisan shifts will not soften US hostility, and Trump said only he decides when the war ends. At sea, 3 ships sank in 7 days and a third US carrier strike group neared the war.

poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the Federal Reserve raises its policy rate by a quarter point at its December meeting. That rate anchors short-term dollar borrowing, so bonds, mortgages and currencies worldwide reprice around it.
poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.recent: The Fed held rates with a nod to December, a decision TD Securities expected to draw 3 dissents. Afterwards, Warsh's muddled messaging revived doubts about Fed credibility. A strong labor market then lifted bets on a hike as Treasuries stumbled.

stocks:GILD.standing: Gilead Sciences is a US drugmaker built on antivirals, and among the largest suppliers of HIV medicines, including the twice-yearly prevention shot lenacapavir. Its shares turn on how long those drugs hold their pricing and on what follows them.
stocks:GILD.recent: A generic version of Gilead's twice-yearly HIV-prevention shot, lenacapavir, was cleared for low-income countries at an expected $40 a year instead of $28,218. That news came after the rise, and nothing in the input explains the share price.

stocks:TSLA.standing: Shares of the US electric-car and battery maker led by Elon Musk. Its valuation rests far more on promised robotaxis and robots than on the cars it sells today, so the stock often moves on Musk's plans as much as on its results.
stocks:TSLA.recent: Musk's political bet failed at the midterms, raising questions over Tesla's China ties, and Tesla opposed new US tariffs on Vietnam. Then it said it would wind down Cybertruck production at Gigafactory Texas next year after weak sales and recalls, with 11,586 sold in nine months by Cox Automotive's estimate, as Musk turns to robotics and AI.

poly-us-iran-hormuz-agreement-by-novembe.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Washington and Tehran reach an agreement on the Strait of Hormuz by November 30. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, on the waterway that carries Gulf oil and gas to the world.

wiki-binance.standing: The Wikipedia article on Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. Millions of retail traders hold funds on it, and much of the market's stablecoin and token liquidity clears through its order books.
wiki-binance.recent: Hackers took $6.3 billion from Binance in a breach that began with malicious code delivered through a fake job interview. The FBI blamed North Korea's TraderTraitor, which Kim Yo-jong denied. Binance said it had refilled 90% of the losses, and once withdrawals reopened customers pulled a net $4.72 billion.

stocks:SHA0.DE.standing: Shares of the Herzogenaurach maker of bearings, transmission parts and electric drives, one of Germany's largest car-industry suppliers. Its earnings follow carmakers' output and how fast the industry shifts to electric.
stocks:SHA0.DE.recent: Schaeffler is cutting 3,500 jobs and closing four German sites, with three quarters of the losses in Germany, as the crisis in Germany's car industry moves down the supply chain from the carmakers to their suppliers. The cuts were announced after the last price on this chart, so they do not explain its slide.

stocks:688036.SS.standing: The Shenzhen maker of Tecno, Itel and Infinix phones, sold cheaply across Africa, South Asia and the Middle East. Thin margins on low-priced handsets leave it exposed to the cost of the chips inside them.
stocks:688036.SS.recent: The one story about Transsion's own business was a cost squeeze: memory now exceeds 60% of the parts cost of sub-$100 phones, the segment it sells into. That pressure on margins runs against the rally, and nothing else in the input accounts for the rise.

poly-strait-of-hormuz-traffic-returns-to.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if shipping through the Strait of Hormuz returns to normal by December 31. Roughly a fifth of the world's oil passes the strait, so the price is a bet on Gulf supply reopening.
poly-strait-of-hormuz-traffic-returns-to.recent: Mines turned the strait into a battlefield: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said tankers hit mines, four were left burning, and UK Maritime Trade Operations counted 11 attacks and three ships sunk in the week to November 4. Iran's 48-hour reopening offer gave way to five conditions, including recognition of its sovereignty over Hormuz.

stocks:2222.SR.standing: Saudi Arabia's state oil company and the world's largest crude producer, with a small slice listed on the Riyadh exchange. The state owns nearly all of it, so its dividend is a pillar of the Saudi budget.
stocks:2222.SR.recent: The rise ran into third-quarter results: profit of $31.2 billion, up 9%, carried by the higher oil prices of the Hormuz crisis. The same day it began expanding an export route that bypasses Hormuz, and a week earlier Saudi Arabia said it will store crude in Singapore's Jurong caverns from 2027, both ways of selling oil the strait cannot block.

stocks:9984.T.standing: Masayoshi Son's Tokyo-listed investment holding company, which owns most of chip designer Arm and has staked heavily on OpenAI. Its shares trade as a leveraged bet on the value of those AI holdings.
stocks:9984.T.recent: The one story in these weeks about SoftBank's own business was a deal for Sceye to fly stratospheric cell towers over Japan, and nothing in it accounts for the slide in the share.

stocks:1810.HK.standing: Shares of Xiaomi, the Beijing maker of smartphones, home appliances and electric cars, listed in Hong Kong. It is one of the world's largest phone sellers, and its car business is the bet investors price on top of that.

stocks:603486.SS.standing: A Suzhou-based maker of home robots, best known for its Deebot robot vacuums, listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange. It competes for the same living rooms as Roborock and Dreame, and sells heavily abroad.

stocks:SK.PA.standing: Groupe SEB, the French maker of Tefal pans, Moulinex and Rowenta appliances and WMF cookware, and the world's largest small-appliance company. Its share tracks household spending in Europe and China.

stocks:PHIA.AS.standing: Philips, the Dutch maker of hospital scanners, patient monitors and sleep-apnoea devices, listed in Amsterdam after shedding its lighting and appliance arms. A recall of its Respironics breathing machines weighed on it for years.

stocks:300866.SZ.standing: A Changsha consumer-electronics maker best known for Anker chargers and power banks, Soundcore audio and eufy home devices. Most of its sales are overseas, much through Amazon, so US tariffs and platform rules reach it directly.

stocks:BLK.standing: The world's largest asset manager, best known for its iShares exchange-traded funds. Its fees are a slice of the assets it runs, so its shares track markets and the flow of money into its funds.

stocks:MSFT.standing: Shares of the maker of Windows, Office and the Azure cloud, one of the largest companies by market value. Its price now rides on whether heavy spending on AI data centres comes back as cloud revenue.
stocks:MSFT.recent: Microsoft offered buyouts to around 60,000 employees to contain costs, while forecasting $175 billion in capital spending this year on its AI push. In the same weeks, Windows PC revenue slid.

stocks:AMD.standing: Designs the processors in PCs, servers and game consoles, built under contract by TSMC. It is Intel's only rival in x86 chips and Nvidia's nearest challenger in the accelerators that train and run AI models.
stocks:AMD.recent: AMD reported a record quarter: data-center revenue jumped 97% to $8.55 billion while gaming cratered, and its sales forecast beat estimates. The gain did not hold. Chip stocks slid after the midterms on a data-centre backlash, and on Thursday AMD fell 12%, twice Nvidia's 6% drop.

poly-will-puma-shen-win-the-next-taipei-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Puma Shen, a Democratic Progressive Party legislator, becomes mayor of Taipei, Taiwan's capital, a post long held by the Kuomintang and often a stepping stone to the presidency.

poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the ceasefire between Israel and Iran is still in force on Nov 7. Its price is what traders will pay on the truce surviving, with Washington's next decision on strikes as the swing factor.
poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.recent: Traders moved back toward the truce holding as the war turned into a liability in Washington: Vance said it cost Congress, Brent fell on peace hopes after the Democratic sweep, and Tehran answered a US ceasefire proposal with five conditions, including recognition of its sovereignty over Hormuz. A third US carrier nearing the region did not reverse the move.

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-repub.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio becomes the Republican candidate for president in 2028. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it trades against the field of rivals to succeed Trump.

poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-us-presi.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if JD Vance, the US vice-president, wins the 2028 presidential election. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome, and it tracks his standing as heir to the Republican nomination.
poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-us-presi.recent: After Donald Trump's crushing midterm election defeat, JD Vance broke with him in public and blamed the Iran war for the loss, while Trump made Defense Secretary Hegseth pay for the debacle. Nothing reported in the fortnight accounts for the earlier dip in late October.

wiki-european-central-bank.standing: The central bank of the countries that share the euro, based in Frankfurt. It sets their interest rates and supervises their largest banks, so its decisions reach mortgages, savings and government borrowing across the bloc.
wiki-european-central-bank.recent: Christine Lagarde said she would leave the European Central Bank on 7 February 2027, announced the same day it held rates despite hot inflation. Euro-area governments have since narrowed her succession to two veterans, Knot and De Cos, while Bundesbank chief Nagel backed a December hike as eurozone inflation hit 4%.

stocks:8058.T.standing: Japan's largest general trading house, listed in Tokyo, with stakes in liquefied natural gas, copper, coking coal, food and car distribution. Its earnings move with commodity prices more than with the Japanese economy.
stocks:8058.T.recent: The climb ended on a raised forecast: the company now expects record ¥1.2 trillion net income, part of a wider windfall in which Japan's trading houses are profiting from war-driven commodity prices, copper among them.

stocks:VNA.DE.standing: Germany's largest residential landlord, owning several hundred thousand flats across Germany, Sweden and Austria. Its share price moves with interest rates, which set the value of its debt-funded portfolio, and with rent rules.
stocks:VNA.DE.recent: Elif Eralp, the far-left candidate likely to lead Berlin's next government, pledged to expropriate more than 200,000 housing units from large landlords, acting on the 2021 referendum that backed it. Vonovia, Germany's biggest landlord, called the plan legally questionable; the fight turns on what compensation the public purse would pay.

stocks:8031.T.standing: One of Japan's largest general trading houses, or sogo shosha, earning much of its profit from stakes in Australian iron ore mines and LNG projects. Its earnings follow commodity prices more than Japan's own economy.

stocks:GS.standing: The share price of Goldman Sachs, the New York investment bank listed on the NYSE. Its earnings ride on mergers, share issuance and trading volumes, so the stock tends to track how busy Wall Street's dealmaking is.

poly-will-ukraine-sign-an-eu-accession-t.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Ukraine signs its EU accession treaty by 2027. Signing comes only after every negotiating chapter closes and all 27 member states agree, so the price is a bet on the pace of talks in Brussels.
poly-will-ukraine-sign-an-eu-accession-t.recent: Brussels judged that Moldova can finish EU talks a year before Ukraine, with corruption the reason Kyiv trails. That is a setback for any signing before 2027. The fortnight's other Ukraine news was the US-mediated talks with Russia in Abu Dhabi, which leave Europe out, and none of it accounts for the earlier spike.

stocks:0763.HK.standing: A Shenzhen maker of mobile-network equipment and phones, listed in Hong Kong and Shenzhen and second in China only to Huawei. A 2018 US export ban nearly shut it down, so US chip rules weigh on its shares.
stocks:0763.HK.recent: ZTE denied rumours that it is selling its smartphone business, reports that hinted at ByteDance involvement. The denial came after the fall in the shares, and nothing else in the input concerns ZTE's own business or accounts for the decline.

stocks:QCOM.standing: Shares in Qualcomm, the San Diego chip designer whose Snapdragon processors run most premium Android phones and whose cellular patents earn a royalty on most handsets. It rises and falls with the smartphone cycle and Chinese demand.
stocks:QCOM.recent: Nothing in the input accounts for the fall. The news about Qualcomm's own business came after the trough, when it showed a public 6G prototype in Shanghai reaching peak speeds near 14 Gbps. Its guidance, reported as impressive but carrying a big catch, landed a day after the chart ends.

poly-pete-hegseth-out-as-secretary-of-de.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Pete Hegseth stops being the US Secretary of Defense before the end of the year. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on reports about his standing at the Pentagon.

poly-will-anthropics-market-cap-be-less-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays if Anthropic, the AI lab behind the Claude models, is valued under $1.25 trillion on its first day as a listed company. It is a bet on how public investors price a frontier AI developer.

stocks:BILI.standing: Shares of Bilibili, the Shanghai-based video platform popular with China's young viewers, listed on Nasdaq. Its revenue rests on games, advertising and paying members, so the stock tracks Chinese youth spending and Beijing's rules for games.

stocks:WULF.standing: A former bitcoin miner with zero-carbon power sites in New York and Pennsylvania that now leases data-center capacity to AI companies. Its share trades on whether those long leases get signed and financed.
stocks:WULF.recent: TeraWulf's data center for Anthropic now rests on Google's balance sheet: Google can take over the $19 billion lease, and take an ownership stake in the project, if Anthropic defaults, which lets TeraWulf borrow on Google's credit. That deal was reported after the shares had already fallen, and nothing reported before it explains the decline.

wiki-data-center.standing: A building packed with servers, storage and networking gear that runs cloud services and trains AI models. The largest draw as much power as a small city, which ties them to local grids, water supplies and household bills.
wiki-data-center.recent: US voters rejected data centers in 38 of 40-plus midterm contests where household power bills had become a campaign issue, and Hinojosa's win left Texas projects uncertain. Nvidia, AMD and Micron fell the next day, and over 100 groups took protests to London, Amsterdam, Vienna and Berlin.

stocks:2899.HK.standing: A Fujian-based Chinese miner, listed in Hong Kong and Shanghai, and one of the world's largest producers of copper and gold. Its mines run from Congo to Serbia, so its shares move with the prices of both metals.

stocks:MU.standing: An American maker of memory chips: the DRAM and NAND flash that hold data in phones, PCs and servers. Its high-bandwidth memory feeds AI accelerators, so its shares swing with the memory cycle and data-centre spending.
stocks:MU.recent: About 12 Micron workers in Taoyuan staged Taiwan's first chip-industry strike, and the company paused work on its $4.5 billion Taiwan plant after the labor spat. The same Thursday its shares fell 11%, alongside Nvidia and AMD, as chip stocks slid after the midterms.

stocks:005930.KS.standing: South Korea's largest company and the world's biggest maker of memory chips, which go into phones, PCs and AI data centres. It carries the heaviest weight in the KOSPI, so its share price moves the whole Seoul market.
stocks:005930.KS.recent: The company's own news over the fortnight was a retreat from selling fridges and washing machines in Hong Kong, part of a wider pullback from China, and a $229 pair of Galaxy Buds. Neither accounts for the share's slide.

stocks:000660.KS.standing: South Korea's second-largest chipmaker and a leading supplier of the high-bandwidth memory stacked beside AI accelerators. Its shares move with data-centre spending and the price of memory chips.

stocks:CELH.standing: The share price of Celsius Holdings, a US maker of fitness-positioned energy drinks listed on the Nasdaq. Its growth rests on supermarket and convenience-store shelf space won through a distribution deal with PepsiCo.

stocks:EQIX.standing: The largest operator of colocation data centres, renting space, power and cross-connections to companies in dozens of countries. Structured as a real-estate investment trust, its shares track demand for cloud and AI infrastructure.
stocks:EQIX.recent: The one story about Equinix's own business in this period came from Cape Town, where a filing in an appeal confirmed it is the developer behind the data centres planned near the airport. A local planning dispute of that size does not account for the move in the share price.

stocks:7974.T.standing: Shares of Nintendo, the Kyoto maker of the Switch consoles and the Mario and Zelda games, listed in Tokyo. Its profits swing with each console cycle, and its own games keep selling for years after release.
stocks:7974.T.recent: First-half results on 2026-11-05 showed Switch 2 sales down 41% to 2.67 million units, with software sales offsetting the weaker hardware. The other company news of the month was a new Pokémon game, unveiled ahead of its November 7 release.

poly-pete-hegseth-impeached-by-december-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the US House of Representatives impeaches Pete Hegseth, the defense secretary, before 2027. Impeachment takes a simple House majority, so the price tracks the chamber's arithmetic.

poly-will-marco-rubio-leave-the-trump-ad.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio, the US secretary of state, is out of the Trump administration before 2027. It is a bet on a change at the top of American foreign policy.
poly-will-marco-rubio-leave-the-trump-ad.recent: Nothing in the fortnight's reporting is about Rubio himself. Democrats flipped 6 Senate seats and took the House, Vance called the Iran war 'the reason we lost', and Trump made the first change at the top: Susie Wiles moves out and Stephen Miller becomes chief of staff from Monday.

wiki-petroleum.standing: Daily readers of the English Wikipedia article on petroleum, the crude oil that refineries turn into fuels and plastics. It tends to climb when an oil shock reaches what people pay at the pump.
wiki-petroleum.recent: Houthis struck at Saudi Arabia's south and OPEC+ held output targets its Gulf members already miss, as oil stayed near six-month highs; Brent ended October at $117.56. It fell below $95 after Iran entered talks with the US to avert war, Aramco began a route bypassing Hormuz and JP Morgan estimated a 1.4 million barrel-a-day surplus.

stocks:2914.T.standing: One of the world's largest cigarette makers, about a third owned by Japan's Ministry of Finance, selling Winston, Camel and Mevius outside the US through its international arm. Most of its profit is earned abroad.
stocks:2914.T.recent: Putin signed a decree putting Japan Tobacco International's Russian business, maker of 37% of Russia's tobacco market and its largest cigarette seller, under state control, and Tokyo demanded a reversal. The seizure came the day after the chart's last close, so it does not explain the climb before it.

wiki-brent-crude.standing: Daily readers of Wikipedia's article on Brent, the North Sea crude blend that sets the price for most of the oil traded across borders, from West African cargoes to Asian refinery contracts.
wiki-brent-crude.recent: An IRGC blockade at Hormuz, where over 30 attacks hit ships in October, and a Houthi strike claim on a Saudi refinery pushed Brent past $116. It fell back once Trump gave Iran diplomacy more time, despite a rebound after the Qeshm strikes, and JP Morgan now estimates a 1.4 million barrel-a-day surplus.

poly-will-anthropics-valuation-hit-high-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Anthropic, the private AI lab behind Claude, is valued at $3 trillion or more by year's end. A private company is priced in funding rounds, so the contract moves on reports of new raises and their terms.

poly-will-anthropic-ipo-by-december-31-2.standing: The price traders pay on Polymarket for Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, listing its shares publicly by the end of 2026. It turns on reports of a filing and on each private funding round that delays the need for one.

poly-will-marine-le-pen-win-the-2027-fre.standing: A Polymarket contract paying out if Marine Le Pen wins France's 2027 presidential election. She lost the runoff in 2017 and 2022, and a 2025 embezzlement conviction carrying a ban from office put her candidacy itself in question.

stocks:TSM.standing: The world's largest contract chipmaker, based in Hsinchu, Taiwan, which builds the most advanced processors that other firms design, Apple's and Nvidia's among them. This is its share as listed in New York.

wiki-inflation.standing: The general rise in prices across an economy, usually measured by a consumer price index. Central banks set interest rates to keep it near a target, so its pace decides what borrowers and savers pay.
wiki-inflation.recent: The Bank of England raised rates and sees Britain's inflation peaking at 4.9%, eurozone inflation hit 4%, and Thai inflation reached 3.9%, above its central bank's ceiling, as the Iran war pushed Brent crude up. The Fed held, though markets now fully price a December hike. None of these stories dates from the mid-October peak, so they do not explain it.

stocks:SHEL.standing: One of the world's largest oil and gas companies, headquartered in London, and the biggest trader of liquefied natural gas. Its profits track crude and gas prices, and its dividend is a fixture of British pension funds.
stocks:SHEL.recent: BP reported a profit surge on a refining windfall, a read-across to Shell's own refining business that landed on the same day as the share's peak. A week later analysts put the operating cash of eight oil majors at over $350bn, money the companies are sitting on rather than spending.

stocks:MPC.standing: The largest oil refiner in the United States by capacity, based in Findlay, Ohio, and the controlling owner of the MPLX pipeline partnership. Its shares trade on the crack spread, the gap between what crude costs and what petrol and diesel fetch.

poly-will-ilse-aigner-be-the-next-presid.standing: What traders pay on Ilse Aigner, the CSU speaker of Bavaria's state parliament, becoming Germany's head of state. The Federal Convention, not voters, picks the president, so the price follows party deals in Berlin.

stocks:VLO.standing: The largest independent oil refiner in the United States, with plants along the Gulf Coast, in Canada and the UK. It earns on the gap between crude and fuel prices, so its shares track refining margins more than oil itself.
stocks:VLO.recent: Valero said freight to Asia now costs $30-$35 a barrel, a premium that boosts US Gulf Coast refiners against those buying crude for Asia. That is a gain for its margins, and nothing else here about the company's own business accounts for the fall in its share.

stocks:DBK.DE.standing: Germany's largest bank, listed in Frankfurt, with an investment bank that earns a large share of its revenue. Its shares move with euro-area interest rates, legal costs and the health of the German industry it lends to.

stocks:002594.SZ.standing: The Shenzhen-listed shares of BYD, China's biggest seller of electric and plug-in hybrid cars. It makes its own batteries, so the same stock carries both its car margins and China's battery business.
stocks:002594.SZ.recent: BYD's Yangwang U9X reached 503.17 km/h on a closed highway in Abu Dhabi, a record for a production car. Separately, Chinese brands now supply 88.4% of Argentina's electric cars. Neither is a result, an order or a ruling that accounts for the share price.

poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-by-decem.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a ceasefire before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will stake on the fighting stopping this year, not a forecast of it.
poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-by-decem.recent: Bettors bid the contract up after the White House said Melania Trump had secured a six-day ceasefire in occupied Oleshky, a local truce rather than a front-wide one. Abu Dhabi now carries it: the first US-mediated Ukraine-Russia talks since February open 10 November, and the EU rebuffed Trump's claim of a deal covering all of Europe.

poly-will-anthropic-have-the-highest-ipo.standing: One outcome of a Polymarket contract on which company lists in 2026 at the largest market value; it pays out if that is Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude. Traders are betting on both the timing and the size of a listing.

poly-iran-leadership-change-by-november-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Iran's supreme leader leaves office before the deadline. Its price tracks how much traders will stake on the Islamic Republic's top post changing hands, through war, death or upheaval.
poly-iran-leadership-change-by-november-.recent: The slide followed Washington stepping back. Trump answered "no" on striking Iran after the midterms, and Vance said the war lost Congress. In Tehran, Mojtaba Khamenei said partisan shifts would not soften US hostility, and Iran set five conditions, starting with recognition of its sovereignty over Hormuz.

wiki-democratic-party-united-states.standing: One of the two major political parties in the United States, and among the oldest still active anywhere. Whether it holds the House or the Senate decides which bills reach a vote and which presidential nominees are confirmed.
wiki-democratic-party-united-states.recent: Democrats swept Congress in the midterms after 43 million Americans voted early, 10 million more than in 2022. Gold futures jumped on the result, and Bitcoin dipped as the CLARITY Act stalled 49 to 50 in the Senate. Obama had campaigned in Cleveland against the Iran war, blaming it for rising diesel prices.

stocks:IOC.NS.standing: India's largest oil refiner and fuel retailer, controlled by the central government. Its profits ride on the gap between what it pays for imported crude and the pump prices New Delhi keeps a hand on.

stocks:HINDPETRO.NS.standing: A state-controlled Indian refiner and fuel retailer, majority-owned by ONGC, with refineries in Mumbai and Visakhapatnam. Its profit lives in the gap between crude costs and pump prices the government keeps politically steady.

stocks:6818.HK.standing: A Beijing-based commercial bank controlled by the state-owned China Everbright Group, with shares listed in Hong Kong and Shanghai. Its loan book makes it a gauge of how China's mid-sized lenders are faring.
stocks:6818.HK.recent: The fortnight's one story about the bank itself was a bribery case: a former Everbright executive and their spouse took 4.29 million yuan in bribes disguised as salaries. It broke on the last day of the window, after the shares had already risen, and accounts for none of the move.

stocks:2357.TW.standing: The Taipei maker of Asus laptops, motherboards, graphics cards and ROG gaming hardware, listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange. It buys memory and chips it does not make, so its margins sit downstream of component prices.

wiki-benjamin-netanyahu.standing: Daily readers of the English Wikipedia article on Benjamin Netanyahu, the Likud leader and Israel's longest-serving prime minister, whose career has spanned wars, coalition collapses and a corruption trial.
wiki-benjamin-netanyahu.recent: Israel's election left neither bloc at 61 seats without the Arab parties, and Netanyahu's claim of Arab voter fraud was contradicted by Shin Bet. Once Herzog opened coalition talks, 67 of 120 Knesset members recommended Eisenkot for prime minister against Netanyahu's 46.

wiki-china.standing: How many people open Wikipedia's article on China each day: a rough gauge of how often the world's second-largest economy and most populous one-party state pulls general readers toward the basics.
wiki-china.recent: Kim Jong Un crossed into China over a newly opened bridge on a visit that reaffirmed ties with Beijing, Treasury pressed Beijing to deliver its Busan commitments "fully and immediately", and Hong Kong sentenced Joshua Wong to 10 years. None of it falls on the early-October peak.

poly-houthi-x-saudi-arabia-effective-cea.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Houthis and Saudi Arabia agree a ceasefire before the year ends. Its price is what traders will pay on the war between Yemen's Houthi movement and the kingdom ending, and so on Red Sea and Gulf oil risk.
poly-houthi-x-saudi-arabia-effective-cea.recent: Both sides escalated instead of talking. A Saudi-led coalition said it shot down a Houthi drone in the Mecca region, which the Houthis denied, and Saudi strikes then killed 17 civilians in Yemen, per Iranian agency Mehr. Riyadh signed a defense pact with Damascus, Syrian trainers arrived, and the Houthis claimed 6 strikes inside the kingdom.
